reset_password.title: Reset your password
reset_password.contents: Click the button below to create a new password for your account:
reset_password.footer: The link expires after 1 hour. If you did not request a password reset, please ignore this email.

settlement.title: Settlement for period {period}
settlement.summary: Below are the details of your settlement:
settlement.footer: If you have any questions, please contact the fleet administrator.

vehicle_assignment.title: New vehicle assigned
vehicle_assignment.body: You have been assigned to vehicle {vehicleRegistration} ({vehicleMakeModel}).
vehicle_assignment.footer: Please confirm receipt of the vehicle.

vehicle_return.title: Vehicle return confirmed
vehicle_return.body: Return of vehicle {vehicleRegistration} has been recorded.

document_expiring.title: Document expiring soon
document_expiring.action_required: Please renew the document as soon as possible.
document_expiring.footer: Ignoring this warning may result in work restrictions.

document_expired.title: Document expired - action required
document_expired.consequence: Your account may be restricted until renewal.

balance_negative.title: Negative account balance
balance_negative.body: Your balance is {balance} PLN. Please settle outstanding amounts.

penalty_added.title: Penalty added
penalty_added.body: A penalty of {amount} PLN has been applied for: {reason}.
penalty_added.footer: Details available in the driver panel.

inspection_due.title: Reminder: vehicle inspection due
inspection_due.body: Inspection for vehicle {vehicleRegistration} is scheduled for {date}.
inspection_due.footer: Please complete the inspection on time.

inspection_overdue.title: Vehicle inspection overdue
inspection_overdue.body: Inspection for vehicle {vehicleRegistration} was due on {date} and was not completed.
inspection_overdue.consequence: Vehicle may be taken out of service.

onboarding_approved.title: Verification completed successfully
onboarding_approved.body: Your account has been verified. You can start working.
